title: GiveawayRS
description: A lightweight and powerful giveaway plugin with animations, auto rewards, and full customization.
body:
# 🎉 GiveawayRS

Giveaway RS is a powerful, lightweight, and fully customizable giveaway plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. It allows you to host smooth, and professional giveaways with ease.

Perfect for SMPs, communities, and large networks, Giveaway RS ensures engaging events with minimal setup and maximum performance.

---

## ✨ Key Features

🔹 Animated giveaway announcements  
🔹 Automatic reward distribution to winners  
🔹 Scheduled giveaways with timers  
🔹 Bossbar & Actionbar support  
🔹 Sounds and particle effects  
🔹 Placeholder support for dynamic messages  
🔹 Fully configurable rewards, messages, and settings  

---

## ⚡ Commands

/giveaway start  
/giveaway menu  
/giveaway end
/giveaway join 
/giveaway reload  

---

## 🔐 Permissions

giveawayrs.admin
